Add To Cart Added! 6 presets of this hand-built medium-gain overdrive pedal; with and without a speaker cabinet IR. A bit about this pedal model: The Leqtique “Rochechouart” is a medium-gain overdrive pedal that offers some additional gain and dirt as compared to the “MAR” pedal. These are hand-built in small quantities by a builder in Japan; and this model is now out of production. This pedal has a nice, compressed tone that both cuts through a mix and is well-suited for more articulate, single-note playing. It also pairs well with boost pedals. Please note: you must have a PAID version of the ToneX software for Mac or PC to install these presets.
